results.text: Telmisartan modulates exercise responses in peripheral artery disease: Analyses of skeletal muscle from the TELEX Trial. In people with peripheral artery disease (PAD), the Telmisartan Plus Exercise to Improve Functioning in Peripheral Artery Disease (TELEX) randomized clinical trial tested whether telmisartan (TEL), with or without exercise, significantly improved 6-minute walk distance at 6-month follow-up, compared with placebo (PLA).
